name: Roll
help:
# roll

MIDI piano roll visualizer

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|-------------|
| color | color | [0, 1, 0] | - | Note color |
| gain | float | 1 | 0.1–5 | Brightness gain |
| speed | float | 1 | 0.5–5 | Scroll speed |
